notes: Central rules from the doctorate application, fee and deadline pages, fetched 2026-10-29. Bern sets no central English test for doctoral applicants; faculties and graduate schools set their own rules. Applicants without a Swiss master's must be formally admitted by the ZIB, and the faculty must check requirements, by 15 October (autumn) or 31 March (spring). The official doctoral subject list (A-Z) has no PhD in materials science, data science, electrical, chemical or civil engineering, or bioengineering. Molecular Life Sciences: the only Faculty of Science PhD document found is a 2005 study plan, so no record was saved. Ecology and Evolution (CUSO): Bern is a partner, with no Bern admission rules, so no record. Geography and Psychology are not STEM fields in the Atlas list and have no record. No page was blocked in this run.
